header: DRIVER BACKGROUND CHECK AUTHORIZATION — FCRA CONSENT FORM

blocks.text: *** THIS FORM IS USED TO OBTAIN YOUR CONSENT TO A BACKGROUND CHECK. READ CAREFULLY. ***
This Background Check Authorization and Consent Form ("Form") is provided by {{platform_name}} ("Platform") to {{driver_name}} ("Driver") on {{form_date}}.

rows: To evaluate Driver's qualifications for providing ride-sharing services through the Platform.
Driver Social Security Number (last 4 digits only on this form)

blocks.text: Driver hereby authorizes Platform to obtain a consumer report and/or investigative consumer report about Driver from a consumer reporting agency ("CRA"), including but not limited to:

items: Criminal history (county, state, and federal criminal records).
Motor vehicle records (driving history, violations, suspensions, license status).
Credit report (if applicable for insurance purposes).
Social Security Number trace and alias check.

blocks.text: Driver understands that the consumer report may contain information about Driver's character, general reputation, personal characteristics, and mode of living.
In accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), 15 U.S.C. § 1681 et seq., Driver is advised of the following:

items: The information contained in the consumer report may be used by Platform as a factor in determining Driver's eligibility to participate in the Platform's ride-sharing program.

Driver has the right to request a copy of the consumer report from the CRA. Driver may request this by contacting the CRA directly. Contact information for the CRA will be provided after the report is obtained.

If Platform takes adverse action (denial, suspension, termination) based in whole or in part on the consumer report, Platform will provide Driver with an adverse action notice that includes: (a) the name, address, and phone number of the CRA that provided the report; (b) a statement that the CRA did not make the decision; (c) notice of Driver's right to obtain a free copy of the report within 60 days; and (d) notice of Driver's right to dispute the accuracy or completeness of the report.
Driver has the right to dispute the accuracy or completeness of any information in the consumer report. Driver may contact the CRA directly to initiate a dispute.
Driver's rights under the FCRA are outlined in the CFPB's "A Summary of Your Rights Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act" document.
Acknowledges having read and understood this Form and the FCRA disclosures.
Consents to the background check described above.
Authorizes Platform to obtain consumer reports and investigative consumer reports as described.
Releases the CRA and Platform from liability for obtaining the consumer report, except in cases of willful or negligent noncompliance with the FCRA.
Understands that providing this consent is a condition of participation in the Platform's ride-sharing program.
Understands that consent is voluntary but that failure to consent will result in inability to participate.

blocks.text: This consent is valid for {{consent_validity_period}} from the date of signature. If Driver's application is not processed within this period, a new consent form may be required.
